name: What materials are used for a new single line water re-pipe?

mainEntity.name: What materials are used for a new single line water re-pipe?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials used for a new single line water re-pipe include PEX (cross-linked polyethylene) and copper. PEX is a flexible, durable, and corrosion-resistant plastic tubing known for its ease of installation and ability to withstand freezing. Copper piping is a traditional choice, prized for its longevity, resistance to corrosion, and antibacterial properties. Both materials offer significant advantages over older piping types, improving water quality and system reliability.
acceptedAnswer.description: New single water lines typically use durable materials like PEX (cross-linked polyethylene) or copper piping.
